children.value: > Fact From Story: ChatGPT, OpenAI’s viral AI chatbot, turns one today.

> > Fact From Story: In less than a year, it has earned the backing of Silicon Valley’s biggest firms, and been shoehorned into myriad applications from academia and the arts to marketing, medicine, gaming and government.
Fact From Story: OpenAI released ChatGPT as a “low-key research preview” a year ago.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A product that is backed by firms and shoehorned into applications is not a low-key research preview.
> > Fact From Story: A year ago, OpenAI released ChatGPT as a “low-key research preview”.
> > > Fact From Story: ChatGPT would go on to become the company’s most popular product… ever — and the fastest-growing consumer app in history.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Something that is popular and fast-growing is a success.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: If something has been released, has been backed by big firms, and has been applied to many applications, it is still relevant today.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If something turns one year old, it is still alive and kicking.
